title: Membrane curvature sensing by model biomolecular condensates.
authors: Anila, Midhun Mohan; Ghosh, Rikhia; Rozycki, Bartosz
one_liner_zh: 该文用耗散粒子动力学模拟粗粒化模型，研究由无序蛋白组成的生物分子凝聚体与脂膜互作时自发感知膜曲率并诱导脂质分选的机制，虽非直接PPI但聚焦IDP凝聚体-膜互作机制建模，方法可迁移至无序蛋白介导的互作研究。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates (BCs) are fluid droplets that form in biological cells by liquid-liquid phase separation. Their major components are intrinsically disordered proteins. Vast attention has been given in recent years to BCs inside the cytosol and nucleus. BCs at the cell membrane have not been studied to the same extent so far. However, recent studies provide increasingly more examples of interfaces between BCs and membranes which function as platforms for diverse biomolecular processes. Galectin-3, for example, is known to mediate clathrin-independent endocytosis and has been recently shown to undergo liquid-liquid phase separation, but the function of BCs of galectin-3 in endocytic pit formation is unknown. Here, we use dissipative particle dynamics simulations to study a generic coarse-grained model for BCs interacting with lipid membranes. In analogy to galectin-3, we consider polymers comprising two segments - one of them mediates multivalent attractive interactions between the polymers, and the other one has affinity for association with specific lipid head groups. When these polymers are brought into contact with a multi-component membrane, they spontaneously assemble into droplets and, simultaneously, induce lateral separation of lipids within the membrane. Interestingly, we find that if the membrane is bent, the polymer droplets localize at membrane regions curved inward. Although the polymers have no particular shape or intrinsic curvature, they appear to sense membrane curvature when clustered at the membrane. Our results indicate toward a generic mechanism of membrane curvature sensing by BCs involved in such processes as endocytosis.
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体（Biomolecular condensates, BCs）是生物细胞中通过液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）形成的流体液滴，其主要成分为固有无序蛋白。近年来，细胞质和细胞核内的BCs受到了广泛关注，而细胞膜上的BCs迄今研究程度较低。然而，近期研究提供了越来越多关于BCs与膜之间界面的实例，这些界面作为多种生物分子过程的功能平台。例如，已知半乳糖凝集素-3（Galectin-3）介导网格蛋白非依赖性内吞作用，并最近被证明经历液-液相分离，但galectin-3的BCs在内吞坑形成中的功能尚不清楚。在此，我们使用耗散粒子动力学（dissipative particle dynamics）模拟研究BCs与脂质膜相互作用的通用粗粒化模型。类似于galectin-3，我们考虑由两段组成的聚合物——其中一段介导聚合物之间的多价吸引相互作用，另一段对特定脂质头基具有结合亲和力。当这些聚合物与多组分膜接触时，它们自发组装成液滴，并同时诱导膜内脂质的横向分离。有趣的是，我们发现如果膜发生弯曲，聚合物液滴定位于膜向内弯曲的区域。尽管聚合物没有特定形状或固有曲率，但当它们在膜上聚集时，似乎能感知膜曲率。我们的结果表明，BCs在诸如内吞作用等过程中参与膜曲率感知的通用机制。
